name: Loka Fabric 2.0.3 — Minecraft 26.3
changelog:
# Loka Fabric / Loka Fabric+ 26.3 — 2.0.3

- Use the Colosseum artwork for loading, with a separate bottom-left LokaMC watermark.
- Center artwork and videos without stretching on ultrawide and portrait windows.
- Use the standard gold Loka loading logo, video on pre-world menus, and slate on Controls and Key Binds.
- Preserve blurred world backgrounds in in-game menus.
- Give Loka UI the Loka Fabric icon and a shorter description in Mod Menu.
